app.name: Guest services
app.offline: You are offline. Information shown may be out of date and requests cannot be sent.
app.demoBanner: Demo content: menus, prices, hours and rooms shown here are samples, not the hotel's real information.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Choose your hotel to see information, menus and services.
welcome.locationDenied: Location is unavailable or was not allowed. Please choose your hotel below.
welcome.locationNote: Your location is only used on this device to suggest hotels and is never sent to us.

home.activatePrompt: To place requests, activate your stay with the private QR code given to you at reception.
home.notAccepting: In-app requests are not yet available at this hotel. Menus and information are shown for reference.

food.title: Food
food.emptyMenu: The menu is not available yet.

cart.title: Your order
cart.noPoolLocations: No pool locations are open at the moment.
cart.confirmationRequired: Room Service will call your room to confirm this order before preparing it. Nothing is prepared or charged until it is confirmed.
cart.confirmationInPerson: A member of staff will come to your pool location to confirm this order before it is prepared.
cart.offlineKept: You are offline. Your order is kept on this device — it will not be sent automatically. Send it when you are back online.
cart.needsActivation: Activate your stay to send this order.
cart.quoteChanged: Some items changed since you added them. Please review:
cart.issue_unavailable: {item} is no longer available — please remove it.
cart.issue_option_unavailable: An option for {item} is no longer available — please remove and re-add it.
cart.keptLocally: Your order is saved on this device until you send it.
cart.notYourBill: This is the total of your app request, not your hotel bill.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Requests go to Reception. Simple requests need no confirmation call.
services.feeNotice: A fee of {price} applies to this request.

requests.title: My requests
requests.subtitle: Shared by every device activated for your stay.
requests.empty: You have not made any requests yet.
requests.needsActivation: Activate your stay to see your requests.
requests.noticeBody: We called to confirm request {ref} but got no answer. Nothing will be prepared until it is confirmed.

progress.confirming: Staff are calling your room to confirm
progress.confirming_in_person: Staff will come to confirm in person

callback.title: We could not confirm your order
callback.body: Our team called to confirm this order but nobody answered, so nothing has been prepared or delivered.
callback.requested: We will call you again shortly for the same order.
callback.unavailable: A new confirmation call is not available for this request. Please contact reception.

activate.title: Activate your stay
activate.intro: Scan the private QR code handed to you at reception. It links this device to your stay so you can place requests.
activate.notPublic: The hotel QR codes displayed in public areas only open the hotel guide — they cannot activate a stay.
activate.haveCode: Private code detected. Please confirm to finish.
activate.roomHelp: As shown on your key card holder.
activate.name: Last name
activate.success: Your stay is activated on this device.
activate.noCode: No private code found. Please scan the QR code from reception again.
activate.privacy: The code is removed from the address bar and only exchanged securely with the hotel.

stay.title: My stay
stay.device: This device is signed in to your stay.
stay.signedOut: You are signed out on this device.
stay.notActivated: This device is not linked to a stay.
stay.postStay: Your stay has ended. Ordering is closed.
stay.pushEnabled: Notifications are enabled on this device.
stay.pushUnavailable: Notifications outside the app are not available. Updates appear in My requests.
stay.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. Updates appear in My requests.
stay.installHelp: Use your browser's Share or menu button and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
stay.billFallback: For your bill, please contact reception.
stay.billNote: Requests made in this app are not your full hotel bill.
stay.billNotAuthorized: Bill access has not been enabled for this device. Please contact reception.
stay.revoked: You have been signed out of this device (room change, checkout or new access code). Please scan the new QR code from reception.

staff.title: Staff companion
staff.chooseDeviceHelp: The shared account identifies the department; the tablet name shows colleagues who is handling a request.
staff.alertNote: Alerts only sound while this page is open. System-wide pop-ups are not guaranteed on locked POS terminals.
staff.callbackRequest: Guest asked for a new call: {ref}
staff.takeoverPrompt: This request is handled by {device}. Taking over is recorded with your reason.
staff.notReceivedHelp: Nothing will be delivered. The guest is notified that you could not reach them.
staff.goToPool: Go to {location} to confirm in person
staff.posWarning: Enter this order manually in the POS. The app cannot check the POS; each order must be entered exactly once.
staff.posDecision: Already in POS — what was done there?
staff.waitingGuest: Waiting — the guest can request another call.
staff.attention_room_moved: Guest changed room ({detail}). Verify before delivering or calling.
staff.attention_checked_out: Guest has checked out. Decide what to do with this request.
staff.stale: This request was updated on another tablet. Showing the latest version.

admin.title: Administration
admin.pmsManual: Source: manual entry by reception (no live PMS check). Update this screen when guests move rooms or check out.
admin.occupantChangeHelp: Signs out every device and issues a new QR for the remaining occupants.
admin.moveHelp: Signs out all devices, flags open requests and issues a new QR for the new room.
admin.checkoutConfirm: Check out {name}? Ordering stops immediately on every device.
admin.qrWarning: Shown once. Give it only to registered occupants. Anyone with this code and the room number can place requests for this stay.
admin.name: Name
admin.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other tablets on that account are signed out.
admin.pmsStatus_manual: Manual/demo adapter — reception maintains stays here. Pluriel Cloud is not connected.
admin.billsUnconfigured: Not configured. Guests are asked to contact reception for their bill.
admin.pushUnconfigured: Not configured. Guests receive in-app notices only.
admin.orderingEnabled: Requests are enabled for this hotel.
admin.orderingDisabled: Requests are disabled for this hotel.

errors.network: Could not reach the hotel. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session_revoked: You have been signed out of this device. Please scan the new QR code from reception.
errors.activation_failed: We could not verify this code. Check the room number, or ask reception for a new QR code.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session expired. Please reload the page.
errors.property_not_accepting: This hotel is not accepting in-app requests yet.
errors.stay_checked_out: Your stay has ended, so new requests cannot be sent.
errors.post_stay_only: Your stay has ended, so new requests cannot be sent.
errors.room_changed: Your room has changed. Please scan the new QR code from reception.
errors.scheduled_departure_passed: Requests are closed after your scheduled departure. Please contact reception.
errors.quote_changed: Some items changed. Please review your order.
errors.invalid_destination: Please choose a valid delivery location.
errors.callback_not_allowed: A new call cannot be requested for this request.
errors.department_unavailable: The department is not available. Please contact reception.
errors.department_account_required: Use a department account (Room Service or Reception).
errors.already_claimed: Another tablet has already taken this request.
errors.stale_revision: This request was updated on another tablet.
errors.not_owner: Take this request (or take it over) before changing it.
errors.not_claimed: Nobody has taken this request yet.
errors.invalid_transition: That step is not possible in the request's current state.
errors.attention_required: Review the room move/checkout warning first.
errors.invalid_confirmation_method: Room orders are confirmed by phone; pool orders in person.
errors.pos_decision_required: This order is (or may be) in the POS. Describe what was done there.
errors.room_occupied: That room already has an active stay.
errors.same_room: The guest is already in this room.
errors.stay_has_no_room: This stay has no current room.
